caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a dark bronze or black horse figurine mounted on top of a tall, greenish cylindrical pedestal with a spiral groove pattern. The horse is standing with one foreleg raised, and there is a long, thin horizontal bar or lance resting on or supported by an extension from its back. The pedestal has a vertically elongated, twisted form, with a base that broadens out near the bottom and a simpler cap at the top upon which the horse stands. The artwork is rendered on a plain, off-white or light beige background, and the bottom right corner contains the name "HARRY GROSSEN" written in small capital letters. Two faint, irregular orange marks appear on the left and right sides of the background.
title: Shoe Shine Foot Rest
